evidence.source: 許慎, 《說文解字》, 竹部 (text via 漢典)
evidence.text: The entry defines 等 as “齊簡” and says it is made from 竹 and 寺, adding that 寺 is associated with the even ordering of official departments. This is an early lexicographic explanation, not independent proof that the graph originated as an ideogram.段玉裁 interprets 齊簡 as arranging bamboo slips into an orderly stack, then connects orderly arrangement with equality and ranks.
evidence.title: 等 děng - 汉典

evidence.source: 《常用漢字二百字探源》, 金真姬 (PDF)
evidence.text: The account reports no known oracle-bone or bronze forms for 等; it records Warring States forms with 竹 and 寺, sometimes with an added 口, and later Qin slips, clerical and seal forms. The oldest examples it identifies are Warring States, including Baoshan manuscript forms. The observed chronology supports this sequence of attestation, not a claim about when the graph was first created.
evidence.title: 常用漢字二百字探源

evidence.text: The entry labels 等 as a phono-semantic graph, with 竹 as the semantic element and 寺 as phonetic. Its pronunciation panel gives Mandarin děng, Cantonese dang2, Middle Chinese fanqie 多肯切 and 多改切, and lists Old Chinese systems without giving a complete reconstruction on the inspected page. This supports the conventional phonetic analysis while the precise sound correspondence needs system-specific comparison.
evidence.title: 等 děng - 汉典

evidence.source: 韻典網, 寺 phonetic series
evidence.text: The series groups 等 with 寺 and other characters under the 寺 phonetic series. It lists multiple Old Chinese values in its reconstruction data, including 寺 ljɯs and 等 tɯːŋʔ, alongside other values in the series. This supports a historical sound-series relationship but does not establish exact identity of pronunciation; the suffix and final also differ in these recorded forms.
evidence.title: 寺 - 聲符 - 上古音系 - 韻典網

evidence.source: 韻典網, 寺 phonetic series
evidence.text: The phonetic-series listing gives 寺 as ljɯs in the displayed reconstruction set and gives 等 as tɯːŋʔ. These are reconstructed Old Chinese forms from the site's system, not directly observed speech. Modern readings on the inspected dictionary page include Mandarin děng and Cantonese dang2 for 等; no modern reading comparison alone establishes the ancient phonetic relation.
evidence.title: 寺 - 聲符 - 上古音系 - 韻典網

evidence.text: The lexicon lists the old gloss for orderly bamboo slips, then early textual examples for rank or class (《呂氏春秋》, 《史記》), equal (《淮南子》 and 《史記》), stairs/step (《論語》), and enumeration or plural suffix uses (《史記》 and 《三國志》). It gives waiting examples from later works such as 范成大 and 《水滸傳》. These are dictionary-attested uses; the page does not establish that each sense arose in precisely this order or provide manuscript dates for every quotation.
evidence.title: 等 děng - 汉典

evidence.source: 中央研究院, 漢字「等」基本資料
evidence.text: The database lists senses including orderly bamboo slips, equality, rank, stairs, kind, plural and enumerative particles, weighing, waiting and ‘until’. It supplies a sense inventory rather than a chronology or demonstrated semantic derivation for all senses.
evidence.title: 漢字「等」：基本資料

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, entry 待
evidence.text: The entry for 待 gives its Shuowen analysis as 彳 plus phonetic 寺 and reports bamboo-manuscript spellings using 寺 for 待, including examples from the Shanghai Museum Chu slips and Mawangdui Laozi manuscript. It also notes that Duan Yucai glossed 等 as the later common wording for waiting. This supports the existence of a writing/word association between 等 and 待, but does not by itself date the waiting sense of 等 to those manuscript examples.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫, 待

evidence.source: 中國哲學書電子化計劃, 《說文解字》寸部
evidence.text: The transmitted Shuowen entry for 寺 says ‘廷也，有法度者也’ and analyzes it as 寸 plus phonetic 之. This describes the received seal-script analysis of 寺; a modern scholarly discussion disputes that analysis and argues that the early graph instead has 又 and a 止 phonetic element. Neither account supplies a specific earlier shape of 寺 as a positional component within 等, so no earlier-form ancestry for the component shape in 等 is established here.
evidence.title: 說文解字 : 卷四 : 寸部

evidence.source: 王安碩, discussion of 楊樹達文字訓解, 東海中文學報 30 (2015)
evidence.text: The article reports a dispute over 寺: it argues the bronze form is composed of 又 and phonetic 止, and that Shuowen's 寸 plus 之 analysis reflects graphic corruption in the Eastern Zhou period. It rejects a proposal that 寺 itself was borrowed for 志 based on sound resemblance alone. This is a debate about 寺 and related graphs; it does not directly refute the later compound analysis of 等 as containing 寺 phonetic.
evidence.title: 楊樹達文字訓解六則及其釋字理論商榷

evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》, entry 等
evidence.text: The dictionary treats 䓁 as a variant of 等, citing its occurrence in the Kong He stele as reported in 《隸辨》. It explains that clerical-script 竹 tops were sometimes written like 艸 and later could be confused or used interchangeably. This is a later variant-form relation, not evidence for an ancestor of the base graph 等.
evidence.title: [A02997] 等 - 教育部《異體字字典》

gaps: No directly inspected glyph images; paleographic statements rely on the opened PDF's textual description and cataloged form labels.
No oracle-bone or bronze attestation for 等 was found in the inspected paleographic account; absence in that account cannot establish that none will ever be identified.
The history between orderly bamboo slips, equality, rank/class, enumerative particles, and other senses is not fully demonstrated; dictionary gloss order is not treated as chronology.

The waiting sense is shown in later dictionary citations and associated by Duan Yucai with 待, but its earliest dated use as 等 is unresolved. The manuscript use of 寺 for 待 belongs to 待 and does not itself attest 等 meaning ‘wait’.
The alleged link to Proto-Sino-Tibetan *tVŋ or derivation from 登 could not be independently verified in primary or specialist sources during this search.

The component sound comparison varies by Old Chinese reconstruction and readings. The accessible phonetic-series source lists 寺 ljɯs and 等 tɯːŋʔ, while not establishing the exact sound correspondence that motivated the historical graphic choice.
Shuowen's explanation of 寺 as 寸 plus 之 and a modern article's proposed 又 plus 止 analysis conflict. This dispute concerns 寺's own graphic formation, not necessarily 寺's role as phonetic in 等.

For component origin classification, 竹 and 寺 in 等 have no independently established distinct positional ancestor form in the sources inspected; no chronological ancestry should be inferred from the shapes or roles.
